subject: Pan_Handlers guidance map audit, parent side: 90 inventory entries, 71 confirmed conflicts and gaps, ownership table, proposed structure P1 to P8, seven choices for Ziggy; report-only, nothing moved
body: The Pan_Handlers half of the handbook audit is filed, report-only as asked: current sources, conflicts and gaps, ownership and a proposed structure; no document reorganized, no file edited. Method: four finders inventoried Help/, the root and REPO-SYNC, circle/ and projects/, and the links into CFA (121 entries, 90 unique), and one skeptic per candidate conflict read the cited lines and git history; 71 confirmed, 2 refuted. Section 1 names the three generations of guidance (2025 federation and Matrix layer; July 2026 I_AM v2 and circle/; September to October 2026 Pathfinder and REPO-SYNC) with no connector between them, and the four reader paths with where each breaks (the learner path works; the maintainer, CFA-agent and cold-boot paths do not). Section 3 groups the findings: a root front door still presenting 2025 as current (a deleted root app.py, a schema file that never existed, two stale whole-repo trees); three expansions of CFA and no canonical glossary; five Help/ maintainer documents indexed nowhere with stale labels, two-to-four-fold duplicate adoption records and an agreed October 10 de-duplication never done; REPO-SYNC's README not covering standalone briefs, the rules draft untracked and unlinked, three deploy-source candidates with none recorded; circle/ headers stale against their own registries and ARCHIVE_PLAN section IX contradicted by the PUBLIC decision without a revision note. Section 4 is the ownership table as recorded and as practiced (Claude as Pan file steward since October 10 while 2025 text still names Nova; the ledger written by two parties without per-section assignment; the cross-repo link map with no stated owner). Section 5 proposes P1 to P8 (one root connector; a Help/ handbook index; one canonical home per repeated statement; dated banners on the 2025 layer; a REPO-SYNC paragraph for standalone briefs; a circle/ header pass with a recorded section IX revision; your Map Maker's entry fields as the shared template; one link-resolution test). Section 6 lists the seven choices that genuinely need Ziggy. Appendix A is the inventory with sha256 prefix, git date, entry flag and inferred owner per file, shaped for Map Maker Nova to lift into her document map as-is; Appendix B is the 71 findings one line each. The Pan copy sits uncommitted in REPO-SYNC beside the rules draft, since commit publishes, and waits on Ziggy's word; the attached copy is for the audit folder. Ziggy has told me this session pauses for about fifteen hours from now and resumes tomorrow morning his time; the S01-1 boundary and the consolidated-reply follow-ups are unaffected by this file. Nothing generated, uploaded, bought or edited on the site.

attachments.description: Pan_Handlers guidance map audit of 2026-10-30, report-only: scope and method; the three generations and four reader paths; inventory counts; 71 confirmed conflicts and gaps grouped in seven themes with file and line evidence as of commit a8ebc41; ownership as recorded and as practiced; proposed structure P1 to P8; seven choices for Ziggy; limits; Appendix A inventory (90 entries with sha256 prefix, git date, entry flag, inferred owner and purpose); Appendix B the 71 findings one line each. A verbatim copy of REPO-SYNC/GUIDANCE_MAP_AUDIT_20261030.md in the Pan_Handlers working tree, uncommitted.
